name: Nooz
author: mightydigital

sections.description:
Nooz is your all-in-one press room solution for WordPress — purpose-built to make managing press releases and media coverage simple, professional, and entirely native to your existing site.

Whether you’re a startup announcing your latest funding round or an established brand maintaining an active media presence, Nooz gives your communications team a dedicated, structured workspace. It adds two dedicated custom post types — Press Releases and Press Coverage — along with carefully crafted settings and a powerful shortcode system that integrates seamlessly with any WordPress theme.

Stop burying your news in generic blog posts. With Nooz, your corporate newsroom becomes a first-class section of your website: organized, searchable, and sorted chronologically out of the box.
sections.installation:
To install the plugin (recommended):

  1. Login to your WordPress installation
  2. Go to the Plugins page and click the “Add New” button
  3. Perform a search for “Nooz”
  4. Locate the Nooz plugin by Mighty Digital
  5. Click the “Install Now” button
  6. Click the “Activate” button

If you have downloaded the latest plugin ZIP file:

  1. Login to your WordPress installation
  2. Go to the Plugins page and click the “Add New” button
  3. Click the “Upload Plugin” button
  4. Click “Choose File” and select the Nooz plugin ZIP file
  5. Click the “Install Now” button
  6. Click the “Activate Plugin” button

If you have the latest plugin folder (unzipped/uncompressed files):

  1. Use SFTP (or other) to upload the Nooz plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory (on your web host)
  2. Login to your WordPress installation
  3. Go to the Plugins page and click the “Activate” link
sections.faq:
What does Nooz actually do?

Nooz adds a dedicated press room to your WordPress site. It creates two custom post types — Press Releases and Press Coverage — along with a structured settings panel and a [nooz] shortcode for displaying lists of either on any page. It also auto-generates the pages your news section needs on first activation.

Will Nooz work with my existing WordPress theme?

Yes. Press releases and press coverage are registered as standard WordPress custom post types, so they use your theme’s existing post and page template by default. The plugin also includes its own built-in display template for the shortcode list views, which can be customized with CSS if needed.

Is Nooz compatible with page builders like Elementor, Divi, or WPBakery?

Generally yes — the [nooz] shortcode can be placed inside any shortcode-compatible block or widget, which most page builders support. The individual press release and coverage post types use your theme’s standard templates, so they display however your theme renders a single post page.

Can I embed multiple lists on the same page?

Yes. You can place multiple [nooz] shortcodes on the same page with different attributes. For example, your main news page might show [nooz type="release" count="5"] and [nooz type="coverage" count="3"] side by side, each with its own settings.

What’s included on a press release page?

Nooz automatically structures each press release with a dateline (location + date), the release body, a boilerplate, a media contact section, and an ending mark. All of these elements are configurable — you set your defaults in Settings and they apply to every release automatically. You can also override certain settings on a per-release basis.

What is the Press Coverage post type for?

Press Coverage is for logging media placements — articles, podcast appearances, TV segments, and other third-party mentions about your organization. Each item links out to the original source. You can add the publication name, a date, an excerpt, and a featured image (such as a publication logo). Coverage items sort newest-first by default and open in a new tab.

What happens to my data if I deactivate or uninstall Nooz?

Deactivating the plugin leaves all your press release and coverage posts and settings intact — nothing is deleted. Uninstalling (deleting) the plugin will remove the plugin files, but your post content and settings stored in the WordPress database are preserved by default, so your data is safe if you reinstall later.

Is WordPress Multisite supported?

Multisite has not been extensively tested. The plugin is developed within the standard WordPress API, so it should function on most Multisite setups, but full compatibility is not guaranteed. If you encounter issues, please let us know.

Is Nooz available in my language?

Nooz is translation-ready. Check the nooz/languages folder inside the plugin to see if a translation for your locale is already included. If not, a .pot file is available that you can use to create a new translation. Read more about WordPress Localization.
sections.changelog:
1.12.1

  • added support for “mdnooz_plugin_install_version” option, to better handle plugin upgrades
  • added support for “mdnooz_plugin_install_date, mdnooz_plugin_previous_date, mdnooz_plugin_date” options, to better handle plugin upgrades
  • added permalink_structure check for improved section url support
  • added section url structure field to settings
  • tested with WordPress 6.9.4

1.12.0

  • changed default “News” page created notice link from edit to view
  • tested with WordPress 6.9

1.11.0

  • added freemius integration
  • improved code organization

1.8.0

  • added option “mdnooz_integrated_admin” to switch between single admin menu or integrated admin menu items
  • simplified and adjusted admin menu items
  • tested plugin with wordpress 6.7.1

1.7.2

  • minor css fixes
  • improved js minify, js file name adjustments
  • tested plugin with wordpress 6.6.2
